breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained two redundant instructions for the time integration method ('Explicit forward Euler' and 'Forward Euler with dt small enough for stability'). The agent correctly identified this redundancy and consolidated it into a single, clear instruction: 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration.' This aligns with the ground truth, which also removed the duplicate instruction.
